parsing_res_list.block_content: ## 3 Methodology

scContam labels every cell c in a benchmark  $ \mathcal{B} $ with a contamination score against a reference pretraining corpus  $ \mathcal{R} $. Two complementary signals operate at different scales: Signal A (gene-set fingerprint) detects distributional contamination; MIA-scFM detects instance-level memorization. The full pipeline is summarized in Algorithm 1.
### 3.1 Signal A: gene-set fingerprint

Definition 1 (Cell fingerprint). Let $c$ be a benchmark cell over gene vocabulary $\mathcal{V}$. For rank-encoded models, the fingerprint $S(c) \subseteq \mathcal{V}$ is the top-$K$ expressed genes (default $K = 2048$, matching Geneformer's pretraining context length). For value-encoded models, $S(c) = \{g \in \mathcal{V} : x_{c,g} > 0\}$.
For a hash family  $ \{h_i\}_{i=1}^m $ with  $ m = 128 $, the MinHash sketch is
$$ \mathrm{M H}_{i}(c)=\min_{g\in S(c)}h_{i}(g),\qquad i=1,\ldots,m. $$
Proposition 1 (Broder, 1997). For independent uniform random hash functions h i : V → {0,1}64,
$$ \hat{J}(c,r)=\frac{1}{m}\sum_{i=1}^{m}\mathbb{1}[\mathrm{MH}_{i}(c)=\mathrm{MH}_{i}(r)] $$
is an unbiased estimator of  $ J(c, r) = |S(c) \cap S(r)| / |S(c) \cup S(r)| $, with  $ \operatorname{Var}[\hat{J}] = J(1 - J)/m $.
The audit statistic for cell c is the maximum Jaccard against the reference:
$$ J^{*}(c)=\max_{r\in\mathcal{R}}\hat{J}(c,r). $$

The maximum is computed efficiently via locality-sensitive hashing of  $ \mathcal{R} $ into  $ b = 16 $ bands of  $ r = 8 $ rows each (Leskovec et al., 2020): any two cells whose MinHash agrees on all 8 rows of any band become a candidate pair, after which we re-rank candidates exactly. This reduces the per-query cost from  $ O(|\mathcal{R}|) $ to expected  $ O(|\mathcal{R}|^\rho) $ where  $ \rho = \log(1/b)/\log(1/(br)) $.

### 3.2 MIA-scFM: loss-based membership inference

Definition 2 (Per-cell pretraining loss). For model  $ \theta $ with masked-language-modeling (or masked-value-prediction) head  $ f_{\theta} $, mask ratio  $ \rho $, and mask realization M, the per-cell loss is the mean prediction error over masked positions:
$$ \ell_{\theta}(c\mid M)=\frac{1}{|M|}\sum_{i\in M}\mathcal{L}\big(f_{\theta}(c_{\backslash M})_{i},c_{i}\big), $$

where $\mathcal{L}$ is cross-entropy for rank-encoded models (Geneformer) and squared error on binned values for value-encoded models (scGPT). The MIA-scFM statistic averages over $K$ independent realizations:
$$ \bar{\ell}_{\theta}(c)=\frac{1}{K}\sum_{k=1}^{K}\ell_{\theta}(c\mid M^{(k)}). $$
